items.quote: And Moses went and returned to Jethro his father in law
items.claim: Moses went and returned to Jethro, his father-in-law

items.quote: and said unto him, Let me go, I pray thee, and return unto my brethren which are in Egypt, and see whether they be yet alive
items.claim: Moses requested permission to return to his brothers in Egypt to see if they were alive

items.quote: And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace
items.claim: Jethro told Moses to go in peace
